title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating deterministic agent task success rates across high- and low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili, Hindi, French, Chinese) to measure disparities in agentic skill usability and performance.
Measuring agent performance on short-answer tasks grounded in regional facts, etiquette, and customs spanning six global cultural regions to assess cross-cultural competence.
